questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: I had never been to Prague before and it was the perfect mix og a location close to home and still far away culture wise.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: I made so many great friends and had the best half-year of my life in Prague.

questions.answer: That it is extremely bad housing in terms of the building itself, but you will find so many friends in the the same situation.

questions.answer: None

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I got all my classes in the first try.

questions.answer: Choose classes twice, and prioritise the classes with friends in it, intead of your interests.

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: I would recommend Exploring contemporary migration trends: Diasporas, Refugees and Environmental migration since it was a subject with a level similar to the danish standard and really interesting.

questions.answer: the one in the start of the semester, from there you get your own friend group and you can plan them yourself.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: be as social as possible and definitly visit U sudu bar or Duplex night club.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: It was easy, although i didnt really feel like i needed to since there was so many erasmus students.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: no not really

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: the customer service was not that great and the general service level, when speaking to staff and administative workers, was poor. Both due to english level and general mood.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Beautiful arcitecture and great places in the city suiting bigger groups of people.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
- be open-minded towards gaining new friends
- dont stress to much when it comes to the courses, but have general interest.
- say yes to as many opportunities to learn the Czech republic, as possible

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Try to dont stick to your friends from the same country as you. Be open to other erasmus students.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: My social life.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Balancing social life and exams.

questions.answer: Yes
